summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01) on May 14, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial results and 2026 outlook via a press release and investor presentation. The company highlighted a pivot to physical AI with EAI robots achieving ecosystem revenue and positive gross margin, raising 2026 robot shipment target to 1,500 units and planning a new robot launch in early June. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation. What to watch: ongoing operational execution in its robotics pivot.
